title: Steampunk Fish Awakening
description: Two explorers in Victorian attire stand on a rocky shoreline at dusk, one pointing toward a large mechanical fish emerging from the water. The metallic fish emits green steam and glowing light, surrounded by concentric green holographic rings and gears floating in the air above a serene lake with a forested background.
prompt: Two Victorian explorers with lanterns stand on a rocky lakeshore at twilight, one pointing in awe at a large intricate steampunk fish made of brass and copper emerging from the water with glowing eyes and emitting green steam. Concentric glowing green holographic rings and floating gears hover above the fish. Dense pine forest lines the far shore under a dramatic purple and orange sunset sky, cinematic lighting, detailed digital painting.
